name: Wuxi Zhenhua Auto Parts Co., Ltd.
summary: Wuxi Zhenhua Auto Parts Co., Ltd. operates as a producer and supplier of automotive components. The company's core activities encompass the engineering, fabrication, and distribution of specialized automotive stamping and welding parts. Furthermore, it offers a range of services, including subassembly and full assembly processing, alongside the production of molds. Established in 1986, the firm is headquartered in Wuxi, China.
